description: Note something you spotted that belongs to a Goal, such as a bug found during cleanup that belongs to the Voice Goal, instead of dealing with it now. Any Goal on the Roadmap that is not dropped, claimed or not. get_status shows the open notes of the Goals this Session holds. With id: resolve it once dealt with (resolved: true), reopen it (false), reword it, or remove it with an empty text.

goal.description: The ID of the Goal the note belongs to.

id.description: A note's ID, such as 'n2', to change it; leave out to add one.

project.description: Another project's plan to use instead of this one's: its name or ID on the dashboard, or its folder's full path. Changes there are marked as made from this project. Leave out for this project.

resolved.description: With id: true once the note is dealt with; false to reopen it.

text.description: What you spotted, in one line; with id, the new wording, and empty removes the note.

name: save_note
title: Save note
